_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your own details. config.json is git-ignored.
name: Your Name
letter_writers_sentence: Writer One (chair), Writer Two, and Writer Three

cover_letter.intro: I am writing to apply for the {position} position in the {dept} at {employer}. I am a Ph.D. candidate in Economics at Your University and expect to complete my degree in 2027. My research is in <your fields>.
cover_letter.jmp: My job market paper, ``<Title>,'' asks <question>. Using <data>, I find <main result in one or two sentences>.
cover_letter.other_research: My other work <one or two sentences on your other papers, with coauthors named>.
cover_letter.teaching: I have taught <course> as the instructor of record since <term>, and I was a teaching assistant for <n> courses. <One concrete thing you do in class.> <One piece of evidence, e.g. an evaluation score with the department mean.> I am prepared to teach <courses>.
cover_letter.closing: I have enclosed my CV, job market paper, research statement, and teaching statement. Letters of recommendation will be provided by {letter_writers}. Thank you for your time and consideration.
